chapter: Back in New York: Heard and Dizzy
title: How he got the name Big Nick
summary: His boyhood friends nicknamed him Foots, Head and then Big Nick, unrelated to music.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: The name "Big Nick", when did that start?

When I was eight or nine years old. You know how children are. Everybody got a nickname. Now, if they didn't like you, you know what I mean, but if they liked you they give you a nickname and so first they called me "Foots", 'cause I got big feet and then they called me "Head" 'cause I got a big head and.. what else did they call
me?...somethin' else...anyway, but one day they come up with "Big Nick" and that stuck. Yeah, that's it. "Big Nick". All right. That stuck, isn't that funny? How your buddies'll do ya? Hahahaha.
So that started outside the context of music; it didn't have anything to do with your sound or anything like that?
No, no, no. Just kids comin' up. Haha.
